company: CHENNAI PETROLEUM CORP LTD COMMON STOCK INR10.0
description: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited produces and supplies petroleum products in India. The company offers liquefied petroleum gas, naphtha, motor gasoline and spirit, kerosene, aviation turbine fuel, automotive high-speed and high flash diesel, light diesel oil, and bunker and non-bunker fuel oil. It also provides lube products, such as paving bitumen, lube oil base stocks, and extracts.
